gloss: way of incense; incense appreciation art

definitions.gloss: way of incense; art of incense appreciation
definitions.explanation: The traditional Japanese art of appreciating fragrant wood and incense, with its own etiquette and games. Together with {茶道|さどう} (tea ceremony) and {華道|かどう} (flower arranging), it is one of the three classical refined arts.

examples.japanese: {香道|こうどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧。
examples.english: To study the way of incense.
In the way of incense, smelling a fragrance is called 'listening' to it.

examples.japanese: {香道|こうどう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧や⟦{華道|かどう}→華道：04450_kadou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{伝統芸道|でんとうげいどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: The way of incense is one of Japan's traditional refined arts, alongside tea ceremony and flower arranging.

notes:
A refined art centered on appreciating the fragrance of {香木|こうぼく} (fragrant wood). Practitioners 'listen' (⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧) to scents rather than 'smell' them, and play identification games such as {組香|くみこう}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {香道|こうどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧: to learn the way of incense
- ⟦{香|こう}→香：17307_kou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧: to 'listen' to (appreciate) incense

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{茶道|さどう}→茶道：04451_sadou⟧: tea ceremony — the way of tea, a sister refined art
- ⟦{華道|かどう}→華道：04450_kadou⟧: flower arranging — the way of flowers, the third of the three arts
